label:
<think>
The compilation errors arise because jakarta.mvc-api 2.0.1 moved all MVC types from the javax.mvc.* namespace to jakarta.mvc.*. The client code still imports and uses javax.mvc classes and annotations such as Controller, Models, BindingResult, MvcBinding, ParamError, CsrfProtected, and UriRef. To fix, update these imports to their jakarta equivalents. The rest of the code (JAX-RS javax.ws.rs.*) compiles in the given setup, so we leave those as-is. No signature or logic changes are needed beyond import updates.
</think>
